name: haiku-100k
description: Keeps every Haiku request under the 100k-token price step: a haiku-case agent that compacts at 100k, a /haiku-100k:setup command for main Haiku sessions, a hook that cuts oversized tool results and flags any request over 100k, and the haiku-build skill (bmad-build flow on Haiku: Opus plans and reviews, Haiku builds and tests).
